title: Check yourself: A call with an unknown outcome, safe retries and the practice

questions.stem: After a timeout, an agent's wrapper sends the same call again at once. Which call may it repeat without any check first?

options.text: Issuing a refund that has no idempotency key
options.says: Ruled out because "a refund sent twice refunds twice".

options.text: Emailing the customer a confirmation of the refund
options.says: Ruled out because "an email that left the outbox cannot be called back".

options.text: Creating a support ticket for the case
options.says: Ruled out because "a ticket created twice is two tickets".

options.text: Looking up the order record by its order number
options.says: A read changes nothing when it is repeated.

questions.stem: A refund call times out, and the tool reports that its outcome is unknown. What should the agent do next?

options.text: Read the records kept for the order, then decide whether any work remains
options.says: A write that may have happened is followed by a read.

options.text: Send the payment again under a fresh key straight away
options.says: Ruled out because a new key defeats the protection that a key gives: "The tool sends the same key on every attempt".

options.text: Tell the customer that the attempt failed and invite them to begin a new request
options.says: Ruled out because the agent would state something unknown as a fact: "the money may have moved, and the agent will say the opposite of what happened".

options.text: Mark the case as resolved and assume the service processed it
options.says: Ruled out because a guess is not news: "it is the absence of news".
